title: Los Alva - LILAC
htmlContent:
Los Alva's "LILAC" is a powerful display that you don’t want to miss out on. He displays excellence from beginning to end with masterful focus. From the sharp lyrics that shows how incredible his pen is, the exhilarating flow that brings excitement, and it’s all over a beat that sounds tailor made for him to snap on.

The flow is relentless and is hard enough to deliver the raw lyrics with the ultimate conviction that really sells is high class level of emceeing to perfection.
